caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent glass candlestick positioned upright in the center against a plain, light beige background. The candlestick is composed of pale greenish glass and features several distinct sections: a flat, round base for stability; a tapering, ribbed stem consisting of a series of rounded bulges; a bulbous midsection; and a slightly flared holder at the top for accommodating a candle. The entire object exhibits clear glass shading and faint green reflections, suggesting its smooth, glossy texture and transparency. There are subtle shadows and highlights that emphasize the contours and thickness of the glass. No additional objects or details are present in the background.
title: Candlestick
